description: dtp/inventory@2 fixtures. For each flow a conforming reducer, starting from the ledger opened for the product, MUST reach exactly the expected outcome for every fact in order (an accepted fact advances the ledger; a refused or duplicate one leaves it unchanged; refusal codes are normative) and MUST end at exactly the final ledger. The bridge is the v1 projection of one location. The contract is the exact profile whose digest the kind registry pins once the kind is registered.

flows.why: lot-tracked product: receipts, transfers, status changes, reservations, corrections, production, shipments, duplicates, late and stale observations, refusals that leave no trace

facts.why: receive ten cases of lot L1 at the dock: a pack conversion, from the supplier
move one hundred jars from the dock to the shelf: an atomic two-leg transfer is one leg with two real positions
quarantine twenty jars at the dock: a status change is a move between positions that differ only in status
reserve thirty on the shelf for a party
REFUSED insufficient_stock: move eighty from the shelf when only seventy are unreserved
fulfil ten of the reservation: the claim shrinks and the stock leaves
release the remaining twenty
a count correction of minus five with a reason
REFUSED invalid: an adjustment without a reason
ten jars consumed by a transformation, linked to it
a shipment of twenty-four jars as two cases against an order, and a half odd pack: several legs, one fact
DUPLICATE: the shelf transfer presented again, byte for byte
REFUSED observation_conflict: the same source and sequence with a different fact
the order source jumps to sequence five
a late arrival: sequence four from the order source after five: accepted, it is new and inside the window
REFUSED revision_conflict: a fact that expected an older ledger
a source that starts at sequence one hundred
REFUSED stale_observation: sequence thirty from that source is beyond the window and cannot be told from a duplicate
sequence forty from that source is inside the window and new: accepted
REFUSED tracking_mismatch: a lot-tracked product cannot hold stock without a lot
REFUSED unit_mismatch: a quantity in kilograms for a product counted in jars; nothing is converted
REFUSED invalid: a pack conversion that is not a whole number of thousandths
REFUSED invalid: both ends virtual
REFUSED invalid: an unknown virtual location
REFUSED invalid: a production leg without its transformation
REFUSED invalid: a reservation on quarantined stock
REFUSED insufficient_reservation: releasing a reservation that does not exist
REFUSED tracking_mismatch: serials on a lot-tracked product
REFUSED wrong_scope: a fact for another product
a whole fact is refused when one leg fails, so the good leg leaves no trace: invalid
the same good leg alone is accepted, at the same revision, proving the previous fact left nothing behind
one case received with its pack conversion spelled "12.000" against the product's published "12": the same revision, matched by value (#99)
REFUSED stale_observation: sequence thirty-six, exactly 64 below the mark of one hundred and unseen, is the newest sequence outside the window
sequence thirty-seven, 63 below the mark and unseen, is the oldest sequence inside the window and new: accepted
DUPLICATE: sequence thirty-seven presented again, byte for byte: the oldest kept sequence is still recognised
reserve four on the shelf for a party
the same party tops up the claim by two: one claim of six, still that party
REFUSED invalid: another party reserves under the same reservation id
REFUSED invalid: a reserve with no party on a claim that has one
REFUSED invalid: a party reserves under the id of a claim that has no party
REFUSED invalid: another party releases the claim
REFUSED invalid: a release with no party of a claim that has one
REFUSED invalid: another party fulfils the claim
the claim's party fulfils one and releases five: the claim is gone

flows.why: serialized product: units move by serial and fulfilment is a move plus a release

facts.why: receive three serialized units
REFUSED serial_conflict: a quantity that is not the number of serials
REFUSED serial_conflict: a serial that is not at the source
REFUSED serial_conflict: receiving a serial that already exists in stock
move two units to the floor by serial
reserve one on the floor
REFUSED tracking_mismatch: fulfilment of serialized stock must name its serials, so it is a move plus a release
ship one by serial and release the claim in one fact
REFUSED tracking_mismatch: a serialized move without serials
reserve the last unit on the floor: the floor is now fully reserved
REFUSED insufficient_stock: moving the reserved unit without settling its claim
ship the fully reserved unit by serial and release its claim in one fact: the release settles before the leg (#85)
